notes: IFRS. Interest paid (8,780) and interest received (14,943) are classified in operating activities per note 35; income taxes paid are in operating. Nothing is added. Two large captive-finance biases run in opposite directions: lease-asset and financial-services-receivable growth in OCF (+28,419 to paidOut) and interest/dividends received in OCF (−17,557). Sales revenue includes Financial Services revenue (58,769, mostly leasing and interest income). Not like-for-like with automakers that book lease fleets in investing (e.g. GM).
